scope: Frozen raw-output expectations (the Gate A manifest LOSAT/tests/platform_native_v011_canonical.tsv and the expectations that reuse them) that LOSAT is known not to match. A listed case passes only when its output equals allowed_actual_sha256; any other output fails. A listed case that matches its frozen hash again, or that a full run does not execute, fails so that the entry is removed. The frozen hashes themselves are never rewritten; an approved new output goes into a new manifest version (Sakai.MG1655.megablast, listed here until PD-NCBI-PLATFORM-VARIANCE 1.3, is in v0.1.1).
